items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
OBSERVED CONTROLS: WASD moves; taps ~0.25-0.4s nudge, holds ~0.9-1.2s cover real distance. Space = Do Action (contextual pick). LMB hovers/selects world objects; hovering shows verb label. Escape opens Paused menu (Continue ~(0.32,0.58), Controls, Settings, Save, Quit). Tab toggles map. Craft UI does NOT pause time — torch durability and night damage keep ticking while menus are open.

PICKING MECHANICS (refined): Hover verb 'Pick X' appears even at long range, but pressing Space only succeeds when actually close and roughly level (same y) with the target — out-of-range Space silently fails (sapling appeared 'Pick Sapling' twice yet only picked after stepping adjacent). Pick ring is narrow: standing on/too close flips verb to 'Examine X'; step back a fraction and re-hover. Aim at the target's own bright pixels; trunks steal hover ('Examine Evergreen') — for saplings beside pines, hovering the branch tips offset from the trunk worked. CORRECTION: trunk-adjacent grass tufts ARE pickable with precise hover on tuft pixels at the trunk edge (earlier belief they were unpickable was wrong, though one such tuft repeatedly failed — abandon ambiguous ones after a few tries). Confirmed yields: sapling -> Twigs; tall open-ground grass tuft -> Cut Grass; small yellow flower -> Petals. Each pick removes the plant.

GROUND DROPS: loose twig-like ground items hover 'Examine Sapling'/'Examine' — not pickable; skip. No feedback (=scenery) means don't click.

CRAFT UI (RESOLVED THIS RUN): Left sidebar category icons at x~0.019: tools/axe ~y0.114, flame 'Light' ~y0.197. Clicking flame opens a vertical recipe column spanning roughly x0.05-0.15, rows at y~0.13,0.22,0.30,0.375,0.45,0.52,0.60,0.77,0.82. Hovering a row's CENTER (x~0.10) opens a detail panel to the right with recipe name, costs displayed as have/need (e.g. 2/2 Cut Grass, 2/2 Twigs), description, and a Build button ~(0.28,0.66). Dark/silhouette tiles are just UNAFFORDABLE — they still open panels on hover; bright tiles affordable. Build sometimes needs a second click (first only highlights). Known recipes: Torch = 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs ('A portable light source'); Campfire = 3 Cut Grass + 2 Logs; Fire Pit = rocks + 12 of some material (unidentified). Clicking tile edges outside the column does nothing — hit tile centers.

TORCH/ITEM DURABILITY: Crafting a torch puts it in hand with a % durability readout (~96% initial) that drains fast with time/actions (~12% per action cycle observed: 96->88->80->72->59->47...). It burned out by Day 2 morning (~8 actions). Torch stays lit in daylight, wasting durability — craft spares in daylight, not at dusk. Multiple torches craftable if materials permit.

NIGHT (lethal without light): dusk warning 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' then near-total blackness ('It's so dark!'); damage messages 'OW! Something hit me!' until death. Survived Night 1 into Day 2 holding a lit torch — torch light keeps you safe. A small dark-blue circular icon appears near the Day clock at night (unexplored).

HUNGER: 'I'm so hungry!' warning occurred. Berries harvested (hotbar slot showed Berries x1, from red-berried bushes — mechanism unconfirmed); Petals hover shows 'Eat'. Food mechanics unresolved.

HOTBAR: Items fill slots in acquisition order; hover a slot icon to read its name and verb (label centered near x0.135 for slot1, ~0.20 slot2, ~0.26 slot4 observed; spacing ~0.07, y~0.93-0.94). CRITICAL LESSON: green icons are not all Cut Grass — some are Petals. Hover each slot to verify counts before crafting; miscounting left me 1 Cut Grass short and unable to build the torch at nightfall, ending the run.

FAILED STRATEGIES (do not repeat): click-to-harvest; Space when only far-range verb visible; standing on a target; hovering trunk instead of tuft/branch pixels; treating ground twigs as pickable; clicking recipe tile edges; leaving crafting until dusk/nightfall; assuming hotbar green items are all cut grass; wandering in darkness; spending daylight debugging UI when materials are missing.

LESSONS FOR NEXT RUN: daylight is a hard deadline — gather materials first (saplings for twigs; tall free-standing tufts for cut grass), verify true counts by hovering each hotbar slot, then craft a torch via Light category -> hover recipe row center -> Build well before dusk. Only adjacent, level, 'Pick'-verified Space presses harvest. Night without a lit torch is fatal. Unresolved hypotheses: berries/petals as food, the bottom bright recipe tile's identity, possible scrolling in the recipe column, blue night icon's function, whether additional recipes unlock with new materials.
